Home.headline: Invite the whole family. Know who is really coming.
Home.subline: Make a beautiful invitation in minutes, send one WhatsApp link, and see every household's headcount.
Home.note: No app for guests • Works on WhatsApp • Hindi + English
Home.looksSub: Each one scrolls like a story, with music, a countdown and your own photos.
Home.stepsHeading: From idea to headcount in three steps
Home.s1d: Pick a design, add the date, venue and a few photos. Hindi or English.
Home.s2d: Share on WhatsApp. Guests open it right away, no app and no login.
Home.s3d: Every household answers once. You see the live count of who is coming.
Home.finalHeading: Your next celebration deserves a better invite

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: For an invite: the details you type (title, names, date, place, message) and an optional photo. For a reply: the name, answer, headcount and note the guest types. We do not ask guests for a phone number, email or login.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: Only to show the invite to the people you share the link with, and to show you the replies. We do not sell data or show ads.

share.title: Who can see it
share.body: Anyone with the invite link can see the invite. Only the person with your private edit link can see replies. Invite pages are hidden from search engines.

delete.title: Deleting your data
delete.body: Open your private edit link and choose Delete this invite. The invite, all replies and the photo are removed permanently.

NotFound.heading: We could not find this invite
NotFound.body: The link may be incomplete, or the host may have removed the invite. Please ask them to send it again.
